title: Presidential Council for Minority Rights' Assent to Bills
what_it_is: Presidential Council for Minority Rights' Assent to Bills

sections.label: PCMR function under Constitution
sections.summary: Under Article 77, the PCMR draws attention to legislation it considers disadvantageous to any racial or religious community, not suggesting changes or withholding assent.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: First, under Article 77 of the Constitution, the function of the Presidential Council for Minority Rights (PCMR) is to draw attention to any legislation that it considers to be disadvantageous to persons of any racial or religious community.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The Council's function is not to suggest changes to, or withhold assent to, legislation.

sections.label: Checks before PCMR review
sections.summary: Bills reach the PCMR after checks by the AGC, MinLaw and Parliament, and no legislation received an adverse PCMR report over the past two terms.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: By the time a Bill reaches the PCMR, it would have been subject to three layers of checks: first, reviews by the AGC; second, MinLaw; and third, by Parliament.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Over the past two terms of Parliament, no legislation passed by Parliament has received an adverse report by the PCMR.

sections.label: PCMR resources and input
sections.summary: The PCMR may, at its own prerogative, seek other resources or references and call on anybody to give necessary input.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: At any point in time, if the PCMR feels that it needs other resources or references, it would be at its own prerogative and it has the privilege to call on anybody to give his necessary input.
